name: Blake Farms Orchard and Cider Mill
description: Blake Farms Orchard and Cider Mill is an agritourism farm in 985 Armada Center Rd, MI, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
